description: This file provides a partial implementation of PHP's mbstring extension, focusing on Unicode and encoding functions. It includes methods for converting encodings, case manipulation, string length, position, splitting, and character codepoint operations, among others.

classes.name: Mbstring
classes.description: Final class implementing various multibyte string functions with encoding conversion, case folding, and Unicode code point operations.

methods.name: mb_convert_encoding
methods.description: Converts string encoding between different character encodings, supporting array inputs and special encodings like BASE64 and HTML entities.

methods.name: mb_detect_encoding
methods.description: Detects a string's encoding from a list of encoding options.

methods.name: mb_strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string, considering multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_substr
methods.description: Extracts a portion of a string, supporting multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_strpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring within a string.

methods.name: mb_strtolower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase considering multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_strtoupper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase considering multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_ucfirst
methods.description: Capitalizes the first character of a string.

methods.name: mb_lcfirst
methods.description: Lowercases the first character of a string.

methods.name: mb_convert_case
methods.description: Performs case folding on a string based on specified mode.

methods.name: mb_list_encodings
methods.description: Returns an array of supported encodings.

methods.name: mb_output_handler
methods.description: Handles encoding conversions during output buffering.

methods.name: mb_chr
methods.description: Returns a Unicode character for a given code point.

methods.name: mb_ord
methods.description: Returns the Unicode code point of a character.
